QuestInfo.name: Strange Ornate Chest
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2140000##k has something to tell you in front of the Three Doors.
QuestInfo.1: Find the ornate chest and retrieve the Temple Keeper's Quill Pen.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: The strange ornate chest moves around every day. If you can hunt it down, you might just find some good loot!

0.0: Tell me, where was my beloved Quill Pen?\r\n#L0##bIt was right where you said it'd be. You probably could have just walked over there yourself...#l\n#k
0.1: Is that so? Was there an Ink Pot inside by any chance?\r\n#L0##bI don't know, you didn't tell me to look for an Ink Pot, so I didn't look for an Ink Pot.#l\n#k
0.2: The flow of time here is really weird. The Ornate Chest changes locations all the time. I wish I'd never put my things in there. Do you think you could help me one more time?

yes.0: Please find my #bInk Pot#k. I know it's going to be hard to find the Ornate Chest again, but it usually appears in front of the walls where the goddess statue is engraved. Maybe this time it will even have some more treasures!

no.0: Oh darnit. I guess I can use my own blood...

1.0: Did you find the Ink Pot?

yes.0: Finally! I can get some writing done. Always keep an eye out for Ornate Chests. You might just find something great.

item.0: I really need that pot! Go look around on the walls where the goddess is engraved.
